name: io.github.mhmdaskari/overleaf-web-mcp
title: Overleaf Web MCP
description: Read, edit, compile, and review Overleaf projects through your own signed-in web session.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio. Sign in once first with `npx overleaf-web-mcp login`.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overleaf origin to use, for a self-hosted instance. Use the same value for login and serve.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_COOKIE_JAR_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the saved session is read from, if not the platform configuration directory.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_ALLOWED_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project ids the server may touch. Unset allows every project.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_LOCAL_READ_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute folders local reads must stay inside, separated by : (; on Windows). Unset allows any.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_LOCAL_WRITE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute folders local writes must stay inside, separated by : (; on Windows). Unset allows any.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_ALLOWED_EFFECTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated kinds of change operations may make, such as overleaf-read. Unset allows all.
